articles.deck: The program begins in May and is open to all students in grade 6 and up.
body: Principal Lamar Vasquez said the program was built with help from parents and local volunteers. Students will meet on Monday afternoons in the Foundry Row fire house, and transportation will be provided for those who need it.
Sign-up forms went home in backpacks this week, and the first session is set for May. The board will review the results at the end of the spring term.

articles.deck: A photo from the Millrace County Historical Society shows the same corner as it looked decades ago.
body: A 1991 photograph from the Millrace County Historical Society shows Hickory Ridge Road from the corner of Orion Avenue. Someone took the same picture from the same spot this month, holding the camera at about the same height.
